newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Cheung Kong Kowloon flats 180X subscribed.
newsitem.headline: Cheung Kong Kowloon flats 180X subscribed.

text.p: Cheung Kong (Holdings) Ltd said its latest sale of an initial 78 units in its Laguna Verda residential development in Kowloon was 180 times subscribed.

Cheung Kong said there were a total 14,000 potential buyers registered as close of a five-day registration on Wednesday. About 90 percent of the potential buyers were registered under their own name with the remaining 10 percent registered under company name, it said.
Cheung Kong said the flats would put for sale on Saturday.
On top of 328 units, comprising an initial 78 units and an additional 250 units put for sale, the company said it would consider to offer additional units to meet the market demand.

The initial 78 units were offered at an average price of HK$8,286 per square foot, before it raised the offer price to HK$8,787 a square foot for the second batch of 125 units and up another three percent for the third batch of another 125 units.
Laguna Verde is a joint venture development between Cheung Kong and China Light and Power Co Ltd.
The size of the flats on offer in the development in Hunghom are ranging 500 to 1,500 square feet per unit.
